text:
Two methods by which thermal energy can be transferred are conduction and radiation.
Which statement is correct?
A
Conduction involves density changes in fluids.
B
Conduction only occurs in solids.
C
Radiation cannot occur in a vacuum.
D
Radiation involves electromagnetic waves.

options.label: A
options.text: Conduction involves density changes in fluids.

options.label: C
options.text: Radiation cannot occur in a vacuum.
